Reviewer-directed fix. trim/collapse/upper, then strip trailing periods and spaces with regex_extract '^(.*?)[.\s]*$' so 'Australia.' structurally reduces to 'AUSTRALIA' before lookup (general rule, not one hardcoded dotted key). map_enum(passthrough=true) maps 'AUSTRALIA'/'AU'/'AUS' -> 'AU' and passes any unlisted letter-only name (ARUBA, SINGAPORE) through unchanged as uppercase text, so genuine foreign countries are neither dropped nor guessed. A final regex_extract '^(\D*)$' returns the value only when it contains no digits, so state+postcode mistypes such as 'WA 6105' become null instead of being emitted as a country; letter-only names are unaffected. 'default: null' is deliberately NOT used, since it would also null real foreign countries.

Charity_Size is ACNC's published revenue-size band (Small/Medium/Large); values match the acnc_size_2022 table keys exactly. Thresholds live in the table. No period is stated per row, so period is omitted.
All discovery values are dd/mm/yyyy and the column states when the organisation was established; a founding date, never a substitute for Registration_Date.
Regulator-reported count of responsible persons (board size).
Reporting-cycle end in dd-Mon form (30-Jun, 31-Dec ...), matching the target pattern; a reporting fit, not a validity date.
One Y/blank column per state of operation: one_hot contributes each set column's name, mapped to the state enum. This is the stated service footprint, not the registered address.
Comma-separated ISO3 list of countries the charity says it operates in; split so each value is one observation, keeping the publisher's wording.
Single Y/blank column flagging Public Benevolent Institution status.
Single Y/blank column flagging Health Promotion Charity status; a separate column, so a separate flag rule.

config.notes:
Reviewer feedback addressed: address.country now uses map_enum with passthrough=true (no '__PASSTHROUGH__' sentinel); listed Australian spellings -> 'AU', other countries preserved as uppercase text. entity.status is NOT mapped: no per-row status column and the extract may include revoked charities, so asserting 'active' would be guesswork. entity_type not mapped: suffixes (Incorporated/Ltd/Trust) are name text, not a structured type field. Columns 29-69 are charitable-purpose/beneficiary Y/N flags with no ontology target. Some Other_Organisation_Names values are person-like (e.g. 'Shannon Schedlich'); trading_name confidence kept moderate for that reason. No per-row observation date; fallback to resource last-modified. Address is a business/contact address (Address_Type uniformly 'Business'), so address.full confidence is moderate. One 6-digit Postcode source defect fails validation by design.

[ext-v1] Approved rules 5-9 (address.*) moved to the new establishment role because Address_Type is constant 'Business' (registered premises). ABN is not unique, so establishment key_paths include ABN plus address columns. entity.trading_name is dropped (editable rule 1) because the alias column mixes trading names with former legal names and cannot be classified by evidence; ext.entity.former_name is added in its place, emitting only the 'previously known as' segment. sector_tag uses map_enum over the publisher's purpose wording (scheme acnc_purpose): the acnc_purpose crosswalk op with one_hot produced only raw column names (key_label) or dropped all values (label), so it is not usable here; labels with internal commas were reworded with 'and' to avoid the delimiter lint false positive. Charity_Size has no per-row period, so revenue_band carries scheme only. Remaining forty beneficiary-type Y/N flag columns have no reviewed crosswalk table and are not asserted. Date_Organisation_Established is used only as date_established, never for registration status or validity.

establishment.rationale: Address_Type is constant 'Business' on every row: these columns are the charity's registered business address, i.e. the premises it operates from, not the legal entity.

relationships.rationale: The registered business address is a premises of the charity.

fields.reason: Only segments explicitly stating 'previously known as X' are asserted as former_name; the held-out alias values ('Walker Close Community Centre', "Donnybrook Men's Shed Inc.") contain no such marker and are correctly left unasserted rather than guessed as trading names.

Address lines joined into address.full on the establishment role; Address_Type is uniformly 'Business' and the rationale discloses that some values are PO boxes, so the contact/premises nature is stated rather than hidden.
Town_City is the suburb/town field; raw casing preserved, no transformation that could corrupt it.
State abbreviations normalised by the state transform; 'SA ' with trailing space in one held-out record still yields SA.
4-digit Australian postcodes validated by the postcode transform; the rationale acknowledges one 6-digit defect failing validation by design.

The passthrough is over-broad: held-out record 2 has Country='Austria' on an Altona North VIC 3025 address, which is plainly a mistype of 'Australia', yet the rule emits address.country=AUSTRIA. The rule cannot distinguish a genuine foreign country from a truncated Australian value, so it emits a factually wrong country for an Australian address; the rationale's claim that foreign names are 'neither dropped nor guessed' does not cover this defect.

Charity_Size values (Small/Medium/Large) match the acnc_size_2022 table keys exactly, the band label is emitted with the required scheme qualifier, and thresholds stay in the table. Omitting period is justified since no per-row period is stated; the draft review status of the thresholds is disclosed.
dd/mm/yyyy parsed correctly (05/09/2023 -> 2023-09-05, 31/12/1889 -> 1889-12-31); the column is the establishment date and is kept distinct from Registration_Date.
Regulator-reported responsible-person count parsed to integer; the 0 value is passed through rather than suppressed, which is faithful to the source.
Financial_Year_End values (30-Jun, 28-Feb, 30-Sep, 31-Dec) match the dd-Mon pattern and are treated as a reporting-cycle marker, not a validity date.
One Y/blank column per state mapped to the state enum, one observation per set column; correctly the stated service footprint and kept separate from the registered address state.
Comma-separated country list split so each value is one observation, preserving the publisher's ISO3 wording ('AUS').
Y/blank PBI column flagged to the PBI enum value; no emission when blank.
Separate HPC column flagged to the HPC enum value; held-out record with HPC='Y' correctly emits HPC alongside its purpose tag.

All twelve purpose columns are covered by the mapping keys and decoded to the publisher's purpose wording under scheme acnc_purpose; source typos in column names ('natual', 'ther') do not corrupt the emitted labels, and commas in the Act's wording were replaced with 'and' to avoid delimiter ambiguity.

critic.summary: The added rules are largely sound: former_name is asserted only on an explicit 'previously known as' marker, the size band carries its required scheme and matches the crosswalk keys, dates parse in dd/mm/yyyy order, the purpose flags are fully covered under acnc_purpose, and the operating-region one-hot is correctly kept distinct from the registered address. Two concerns. First, rule 5's country passthrough emits AUSTRIA for a record whose address is Altona North VIC 3025, i.e. it cannot tell a genuine foreign country from a truncated 'Australia' and produces a wrong country claim. Second, the ~28 beneficiary Y/N columns are the same concept as rule 14's purpose flags (the ontology names acnc_beneficiary as a sector_tag scheme) yet are all left unmapped, so the beneficiary half of the sector_tag concept is missing. The establishment role for the address is a defensible but debatable choice given Address_Type is uniformly 'Business'; the rationale does disclose the PO-box caveat.
